newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bank Komercni 1996 results delayed.
newsitem.headline: Czech bank Komercni 1996 results delayed.

text.p: Komercni Banka a.s., the Czech Republic's largest commercial bank, said on Friday it has delayed publishing preliminary 1996 results which were expected earlier in the day.

Bank spokeswoman Irena Satavova said the bank was still in talks with its auditors on the matter, but would submit preliminary results under Czech accounting standards to the Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) later on Friday.
She added that there may be more information on the subject made available to journalists in the afternoon.
Some dealers said trading in Komercni Banka shares was very thin as investors were waiting for the results.
Komercni shares fell 70 crowns to 2,735 at the PSE's daily price fixing.
